then.text: Told the Duty Officer yet? The runway never gets any shorter, but the paperwork does.

else.text: Right, since you ask about the Airbridge. Brize to Ascension is a little over 6,000 kilometres, and Ascension to the Falklands is about the same again.
So the Airbridge has one stop and a great deal of sea. Go and tell the Duty Officer, and keep your elbows in on the stairs.
This is the tower. We look after about a hundred movements a day, on a quiet one. The big windows at the top are not for the view: they're for seeing what's about to hit us.
I sit here with a mug of tea and a radio and tell very large aeroplanes where to go. It's the best job in the Air Force.
